releases.name: Frog Parkour Obby
releases.summary:
Play as a frog and take on a colorful parkour obstacle course filled with moving platforms, powerful jump pads, dangerous traps, and tricky jumps. Reach the end of each level and prove your parkour skills.

Looking for a tougher challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake sends you all the way back.

releases.name: Eggstreme Farming
releases.summary: Build and manage your own farm! Take care of chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys, collect and sell eggs, buy new animals, expand your pens, and turn your farm into a thriving egg-production empire.

releases.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
releases.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?
